desk.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Zoé's board for the Water Office: a pin for every house waiting for the project's heat. Ours is near the top.

trunk.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: The old travel trunk. Desert Island, Zeelich... these days it holds seed packets.

mend.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Things to take back: Gilbert's kettle, the baker's scales. Gilbert will want the kettle before he wants to say thanks.

meter.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: The heat meter. Not connected yet. Zoé got us on the list.

bench.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Arthur's paddle boat, built to beat Lulu's. The plan says "rudder needs pin (pliers?)". So that's where my pliers went.

pump look lines: n_hero: The old pump. Seized, and dry as the well.
bram lines: n_bram: Dry as the well. Everything is, this morning.
boat box lines: n_hero: Paint, string, a spare sail... and my pliers. Arthur.
odile lines: n_odile: Cargo permits? Harbour master's stamp, not mine. Doran. If you can wake him.
nell lines: n_nell: Arthur's dad, right? He still owes me a sprocket.
n_nell: Esmer engines are wonderful machines. Try getting a spare part for one, though. Three weeks, by shuttle.
